summary: Node::parent treated a child with a full array of child pointers as completely dense even when its descendants were sparse. This incorrectly retained Size::Size accounting, causing incorrect subtree offsets during indexing and splitting. The fix checks is_completely_dense(level - 1), forcing cumulative Size::Table accounting for a sparse nonfinal child. The upstream issue_55_back regression test exercises repeated prepending followed by indexing and slicing. This is a proposed reversal; reproduction has not been run.
